confirmedFeatures: 2027 model pages and 26/27 collection listings confirm the product season label.
Nitro describes three toe/heel connection points, an asymmetric Step On highback with entry funnel, Re:Flex mounting, Hook 2 toe hooks and HYPER Foam footbed.

Nitro's official Step On guide says Nitro bindings are compatible with all Step On boots, but the system is gender- and size-specific; men's boots pair with men's bindings and women's boots with women's bindings.
Men's official boot-size ranges map to S/M/L/XL; women's ranges map to S/M/L. Both charts have no overlap between the listed recommended ranges.
